Title: Network Watcher is now Generally Available in South Africa North

Body.Content:
Azure Network Watcher is now generally available in South Africa North region.  

Network Watcher is a cloud based solution for troubleshooting and monitoring networks in Azure. With Network Watcher you can:

  • Troubleshoot and localize connectivity issues 
  • Perform packet captures to detect application behavior
  • Check configuration (eg. routing) issues in complex topology environments
  • Audit your networks with NSG Flow Logs and Traffic Analytics (available regions)
  • Monitor network connectivity within the cloud and across hybrid environments using Connection Monitor and Network Performance Monitor

Learn more about Network Watcher.  Check out our documentation for more information.
